description: Localisation et caractéristiques des installations de production d'électricité pour les sites de Rennes, Ville et Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole - Direction du Patrimoine Bâti. Cette couche localise et indique les caractéristiques des installations de production d'électricité (photovoltaïque et cogénération) pour les bâtiments ou les sites de la Ville de Rennes et de Rennes Métropole. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Réseaux, Energie. Its keywords are production d'énergie électrique, cogénération. The portal shows 1 records. The portal shows 2025-02-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
